#define __SFR_OFFSET 0
#include <avr/io.h>

/*
 * Project: Sample71_Multitasking_Industrial_Process_Mixer - Sample71 Multitasking Industrial Process Mixer
 * Target MCU: Microchip ATmega328P (16 MHz)
 * Language: Pure AVR Assembly
 */

.global main

main:
    ; Initialize Stack Pointer
    ldi     r16, lo8(RAMEND)
    out     SPL, r16
    ldi     r16, hi8(RAMEND)
    out     SPH, r16

    ; Configure LCD Pins: PB3(EN), PB4(RS) as Output
    sbi     DDRB, 3
    sbi     DDRB, 4
    cbi     PORTB, 3
    cbi     PORTB, 4

    ; Configure LCD Data: PD2..PD5 as Output
    sbi     DDRD, 2
    sbi     DDRD, 3
    sbi     DDRD, 4
    sbi     DDRD, 5

    ; Configure Buttons: PB0, PB1, PB2 as Input with Pull-Up
    cbi     DDRB, 0
    cbi     DDRB, 1
    cbi     DDRB, 2
    sbi     PORTB, 0
    sbi     PORTB, 1
    sbi     PORTB, 2

    ; Configure Output LEDs: PB5(D13), PC1(A1), PC2(A2)
    sbi     DDRB, 5
    sbi     DDRC, 1
    sbi     DDRC, 2
    cbi     PORTB, 5
    cbi     PORTC, 1
    cbi     PORTC, 2

    ; Init ADC (Channel A0, AVcc ref)
    ldi     r16, (1 << REFS0)
    sts     ADMUX, r16
    ldi     r16, (1 << ADEN) | (1 << ADPS2) | (1 << ADPS1) | (1 << ADPS0)
    sts     ADCSRA, r16

    ; Init LCD 4-bit
    rcall   lcd_init_seq

    ; Main Multitasking Super-Loop
loop:
    ; Task 1: Check SW1 (PB0) -> Toggle LED1 (PB5)
    sbis    PINB, 0
    sbi     PORTB, 5
    sbic    PINB, 0
    cbi     PORTB, 5

    ; Task 2: Check SW2 (PB1) -> Set LED2 (PC1)
    sbis    PINB, 1
    sbi     PORTC, 1
    sbic    PINB, 1
    cbi     PORTC, 1

    ; Task 3: Read ADC0 and test threshold
    lds     r16, ADCSRA
    sbr     r16, (1 << ADSC)
    sts     ADCSRA, r16
adc_wait:
    lds     r16, ADCSRA
    sbrc    r16, ADSC
    rjmp    adc_wait
    lds     r16, ADCH
    cpi     r16, 2
    brlo    adc_low
    sbi     PORTC, 2
    rjmp    adc_done
adc_low:
    cbi     PORTC, 2
adc_done:
    rcall   delay_10ms
    rjmp    loop

lcd_init_seq:
    rcall   delay_50ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x02
    rcall   lcd_nibble

    ldi     r16, 0x28
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x0C
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x06
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x01
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    rcall   delay_10ms

    ; Print title on line 1
    ldi     r16, 0x80
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     ZL, lo8(str_title)
    ldi     ZH, hi8(str_title)
    rcall   print_str
    ret

print_str:
    lpm     r16, Z+
    tst     r16
    breq    str_ret
    rcall   lcd_data
    rjmp    print_str
str_ret:
    ret

str_title:
    .asciz "MULTITASK MASTER"

lcd_cmd:
    cbi     PORTB, 4
    push    r16
    swap    r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    pop     r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    ret

asmCode:
#define __SFR_OFFSET 0
#include <avr/io.h>

/*
 * Project: Sample76_Multitasking_Greenhouse_Climate_HVAC - Sample76 Multitasking Greenhouse Climate HVAC
 * Target MCU: Microchip ATmega328P (16 MHz)
 * Language: Pure AVR Assembly
 */

.global main

main:
    ; Initialize Stack Pointer
    ldi     r16, lo8(RAMEND)
    out     SPL, r16
    ldi     r16, hi8(RAMEND)
    out     SPH, r16

    ; Configure LCD Pins: PB3(EN), PB4(RS) as Output
    sbi     DDRB, 3
    sbi     DDRB, 4
    cbi     PORTB, 3
    cbi     PORTB, 4

    ; Configure LCD Data: PD2..PD5 as Output
    sbi     DDRD, 2
    sbi     DDRD, 3
    sbi     DDRD, 4
    sbi     DDRD, 5

    ; Configure Buttons: PB0, PB1, PB2 as Input with Pull-Up
    cbi     DDRB, 0
    cbi     DDRB, 1
    cbi     DDRB, 2
    sbi     PORTB, 0
    sbi     PORTB, 1
    sbi     PORTB, 2

    ; Configure Output LEDs: PB5(D13), PC1(A1), PC2(A2)
    sbi     DDRB, 5
    sbi     DDRC, 1
    sbi     DDRC, 2
    cbi     PORTB, 5
    cbi     PORTC, 1
    cbi     PORTC, 2

    ; Init ADC (Channel A0, AVcc ref)
    ldi     r16, (1 << REFS0)
    sts     ADMUX, r16
    ldi     r16, (1 << ADEN) | (1 << ADPS2) | (1 << ADPS1) | (1 << ADPS0)
    sts     ADCSRA, r16

    ; Init LCD 4-bit
    rcall   lcd_init_seq

    ; Main Multitasking Super-Loop
loop:
    ; Task 1: Check SW1 (PB0) -> Toggle LED1 (PB5)
    sbis    PINB, 0
    sbi     PORTB, 5
    sbic    PINB, 0
    cbi     PORTB, 5

    ; Task 2: Check SW2 (PB1) -> Set LED2 (PC1)
    sbis    PINB, 1
    sbi     PORTC, 1
    sbic    PINB, 1
    cbi     PORTC, 1

    ; Task 3: Read ADC0 and test threshold
    lds     r16, ADCSRA
    sbr     r16, (1 << ADSC)
    sts     ADCSRA, r16
adc_wait:
    lds     r16, ADCSRA
    sbrc    r16, ADSC
    rjmp    adc_wait
    lds     r16, ADCH
    cpi     r16, 2
    brlo    adc_low
    sbi     PORTC, 2
    rjmp    adc_done
adc_low:
    cbi     PORTC, 2
adc_done:
    rcall   delay_10ms
    rjmp    loop

lcd_init_seq:
    rcall   delay_50ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x02
    rcall   lcd_nibble

    ldi     r16, 0x28
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x0C
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x06
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x01
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    rcall   delay_10ms

    ; Print title on line 1
    ldi     r16, 0x80
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     ZL, lo8(str_title)
    ldi     ZH, hi8(str_title)
    rcall   print_str
    ret

print_str:
    lpm     r16, Z+
    tst     r16
    breq    str_ret
    rcall   lcd_data
    rjmp    print_str
str_ret:
    ret

str_title:
    .asciz "MULTITASK MASTER"

lcd_cmd:
    cbi     PORTB, 4
    push    r16
    swap    r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    pop     r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    ret

lcd_data:
    sbi     PORTB, 4
    push    r16
    swap    r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    pop     r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    ret

lcd_nibble:
    in      r17, PORTD
    andi    r17, 0xC3
    sbrc    r16, 0
    ori     r17, (1 << 5)
    sbrc    r16, 1
    ori     r17, (1 << 4)
    sbrc    r16, 2
    ori     r17, (1 << 3)
    sbrc    r16, 3
    ori     r17, (1 << 2)
    out     PORTD, r17
    sbi     PORTB, 3
    nop
    nop
    cbi     PORTB, 3
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ret

delay_10ms:
    ldi     r20, 20
d1: ldi     r21, 200
d2: dec     r21
    brne    d2
    dec     r20
    brne    d1
    ret

delay_50ms:
    ldi     r22, 5
d3: rcall   delay_10ms
    dec     r22
    brne    d3
    ret

    cbi     DDRB, 2
    sbi     PORTB, 0
    sbi     PORTB, 1
    sbi     PORTB, 2

    ; Configure Output LEDs: PB5(D13), PC1(A1), PC2(A2)
    sbi     DDRB, 5
    sbi     DDRC, 1
    sbi     DDRC, 2
    cbi     PORTB, 5
    cbi     PORTC, 1
    cbi     PORTC, 2

    ; Init ADC (Channel A0, AVcc ref)
    ldi     r16, (1 << REFS0)
    sts     ADMUX, r16
    ldi     r16, (1 << ADEN) | (1 << ADPS2) | (1 << ADPS1) | (1 << ADPS0)
    sts     ADCSRA, r16

    ; Init LCD 4-bit
    rcall   lcd_init_seq

    ; Main Multitasking Super-Loop
loop:
    ; Task 1: Check SW1 (PB0) -> Toggle LED1 (PB5)
    sbis    PINB, 0
    sbi     PORTB, 5
    sbic    PINB, 0
    cbi     PORTB, 5

    ; Task 2: Check SW2 (PB1) -> Set LED2 (PC1)
    sbis    PINB, 1
    sbi     PORTC, 1
    sbic    PINB, 1
    cbi     PORTC, 1

    ; Task 3: Read ADC0 and test threshold
    lds     r16, ADCSRA
    sbr     r16, (1 << ADSC)
    sts     ADCSRA, r16
adc_wait:
    lds     r16, ADCSRA
    sbrc    r16, ADSC
    rjmp    adc_wait
    lds     r16, ADCH
    cpi     r16, 2
    brlo    adc_low
    sbi     PORTC, 2
    rjmp    adc_done
adc_low:
    cbi     PORTC, 2
adc_done:
    rcall   delay_10ms
    rjmp    loop

lcd_init_seq:
    rcall   delay_50ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x02
    rcall   lcd_nibble

    ldi     r16, 0x28
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x0C
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x06
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x01
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    rcall   delay_10ms

    ; Print title on line 1
    ldi     r16, 0x80
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     ZL, lo8(str_title)
    ldi     ZH, hi8(str_title)
    rcall   print_str
    ret

print_str:
    lpm     r16, Z+
    tst     r16
    breq    str_ret
    rcall   lcd_data
    rjmp    print_str
str_ret:
    ret

str_title:
    .asciz "MULTITASK MASTER"

lcd_cmd:
    cbi     PORTB, 4
    push    r16
    swap    r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    pop     r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    ret

lcd_data:
    sbi     PORTB, 4
    push    r16
    swap    r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    pop     r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    ret

lcd_nibble:
    in      r17, PORTD
    andi    r17, 0xC3
    sbrc    r16, 0
    ori     r17, (1 << 5)
    sbrc    r16, 1
    ori     r17, (1 << 4)
    sbrc    r16, 2
    ori     r17, (1 << 3)
    sbrc    r16, 3
    ori     r17, (1 << 2)
    out     PORTD, r17
    sbi     PORTB, 3
    nop
    nop
    cbi     PORTB, 3
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ret

delay_10ms:
    ldi     r20, 20
d1: ldi     r21, 200
d2: dec     r21
    brne    d2
    dec     r20
    brne    d1
    ret

delay_50ms:
    ldi     r22, 5
d3: rcall   delay_10ms
    dec     r22
    brne    d3
    ret

checklist: ตรวจสอบสายไฟและขั้วอุปกรณ์ให้ถูกต้องก่อนจ่ายไฟเลี้ยง
สามารถกดปุ่มจำลองใน SimulIDE เพื่อทดสอบพฤติกรรมวงจรก่อนเบิร์นลงบอร์ดจริง
หากเกิดข้อผิดพลาดในการคอมไพล์ ให้ตรวจดูรีจิสเตอร์และบิตไวส์ในโค้ด C
asmCode:
#define __SFR_OFFSET 0
#include <avr/io.h>

/*
 * Project: Sample78_Multitasking_Dual_Display_Workcell - Sample78 Multitasking Dual Display Workcell
 * Target MCU: Microchip ATmega328P (16 MHz)
 * Language: Pure AVR Assembly
 */

.global main

main:
    ; Initialize Stack Pointer
    ldi     r16, lo8(RAMEND)
    out     SPL, r16
    ldi     r16, hi8(RAMEND)
    out     SPH, r16

    ; Configure 7-Segment PORTD (PD0..PD7) as Output
    ldi     r16, 0xFF
    out     DDRD, r16
    clr     r16
    out     PORTD, r16

    ; Configure LEDs: PB0, PB1 as Output
    sbi     DDRB, 0
    sbi     DDRB, 1
    cbi     PORTB, 0
    cbi     PORTB, 1

    ; Configure Buttons: PC1, PC2, PC3 as Input with Pull-Up
    cbi     DDRC, 1
    cbi     DDRC, 2
    cbi     DDRC, 3
    sbi     PORTC, 1
    sbi     PORTC, 2
    sbi     PORTC, 3

    ; Configure ADC (Channel A0, AVcc ref)
    ldi     r16, (1 << REFS0)
    sts     ADMUX, r16
    ldi     r16, (1 << ADEN) | (1 << ADPS2) | (1 << ADPS1) | (1 << ADPS0)
    sts     ADCSRA, r16

    clr     r24 ; Current digit 0-9

loop:
    ; Task 1: Check SW1 (PC1) -> Increment digit
    sbic    PINC, 1
    rjmp    check_sw2
    inc     r24
    cpi     r24, 10
    brlo    update_seg
    clr     r24

update_seg:
    rcall   show_digit
    rcall   delay_deb

check_sw2:
    ; Task 2: Check SW2 (PC2) -> Toggle LED1 (PB0)
    sbis    PINC, 2
    sbi     PORTB, 0
    sbic    PINC, 2
    cbi     PORTB, 0

    ; Task 3: ADC read -> if > 512 turn on LED2 (PB1)
    lds     r16, ADCSRA
    sbr     r16, (1 << ADSC)
    sts     ADCSRA, r16
adc_wait:
    lds     r16, ADCSRA
    sbrc    r16, ADSC
    rjmp    adc_wait
    lds     r16, ADCH
    cpi     r16, 2
    brlo    adc_low
    sbi     PORTB, 1
    rjmp    adc_done
adc_low:
    cbi     PORTB, 1
adc_done:
    rjmp    loop

show_digit:
    ldi     ZL, lo8(font_table)
    ldi     ZH, hi8(font_table)
    add     ZL, r24
    adc     ZH, r1 ; r1 is 0
    lpm     r16, Z
    out     PORTD, r16
    ret

font_table:
    .byte 0x3F, 0x06, 0x5B, 0x4F, 0x66, 0x6D, 0x7D, 0x07, 0x7F, 0x6F

delay_deb:
    ldi     r20, 50
d1: ldi     r21, 250
d2: dec     r21
    brne    d2
    dec     r20
    brne    d1
    ret

asmCode:
#define __SFR_OFFSET 0
#include <avr/io.h>

/*
 * Project: Sample80_Multitasking_Ultimate_Grand_Prix_Master - Sample80 Multitasking Ultimate Grand Prix Master
 * Target MCU: Microchip ATmega328P (16 MHz)
 * Language: Pure AVR Assembly
 */

.global main

main:
    ; Initialize Stack Pointer
    ldi     r16, lo8(RAMEND)
    out     SPL, r16
    ldi     r16, hi8(RAMEND)
    out     SPH, r16

    ; Configure LCD Pins: PB3(EN), PB4(RS) as Output
    sbi     DDRB, 3
    sbi     DDRB, 4
    cbi     PORTB, 3
    cbi     PORTB, 4

    ; Configure LCD Data: PD2..PD5 as Output
    sbi     DDRD, 2
    sbi     DDRD, 3
    sbi     DDRD, 4
    sbi     DDRD, 5

    ; Configure Buttons: PB0, PB1, PB2 as Input with Pull-Up
    cbi     DDRB, 0
    cbi     DDRB, 1
    cbi     DDRB, 2
    sbi     PORTB, 0
    sbi     PORTB, 1
    sbi     PORTB, 2

    ; Configure Output LEDs: PB5(D13), PC1(A1), PC2(A2)
    sbi     DDRB, 5
    sbi     DDRC, 1
    sbi     DDRC, 2
    cbi     PORTB, 5
    cbi     PORTC, 1
    cbi     PORTC, 2

    ; Init ADC (Channel A0, AVcc ref)
    ldi     r16, (1 << REFS0)
    sts     ADMUX, r16
    ldi     r16, (1 << ADEN) | (1 << ADPS2) | (1 << ADPS1) | (1 << ADPS0)
    sts     ADCSRA, r16

    ; Init LCD 4-bit
    rcall   lcd_init_seq

    ; Main Multitasking Super-Loop
loop:
    ; Task 1: Check SW1 (PB0) -> Toggle LED1 (PB5)
    sbis    PINB, 0
    sbi     PORTB, 5
    sbic    PINB, 0
    cbi     PORTB, 5

    ; Task 2: Check SW2 (PB1) -> Set LED2 (PC1)
    sbis    PINB, 1
    sbi     PORTC, 1
    sbic    PINB, 1
    cbi     PORTC, 1

    ; Task 3: Read ADC0 and test threshold
    lds     r16, ADCSRA
    sbr     r16, (1 << ADSC)
    sts     ADCSRA, r16
adc_wait:
    lds     r16, ADCSRA
    sbrc    r16, ADSC
    rjmp    adc_wait
    lds     r16, ADCH
    cpi     r16, 2
    brlo    adc_low
    sbi     PORTC, 2
    rjmp    adc_done
adc_low:
    cbi     PORTC, 2
adc_done:
    rcall   delay_10ms
    rjmp    loop

lcd_init_seq:
    rcall   delay_50ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x03
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ldi     r16, 0x02
    rcall   lcd_nibble

    ldi     r16, 0x28
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x0C
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x06
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     r16, 0x01
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    rcall   delay_10ms

    ; Print title on line 1
    ldi     r16, 0x80
    rcall   lcd_cmd
    ldi     ZL, lo8(str_title)
    ldi     ZH, hi8(str_title)
    rcall   print_str
    ret

print_str:
    lpm     r16, Z+
    tst     r16
    breq    str_ret
    rcall   lcd_data
    rjmp    print_str
str_ret:
    ret

str_title:
    .asciz "MULTITASK MASTER"

lcd_cmd:
    cbi     PORTB, 4
    push    r16
    swap    r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    pop     r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    ret

lcd_data:
    sbi     PORTB, 4
    push    r16
    swap    r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    pop     r16
    rcall   lcd_nibble
    ret

lcd_nibble:
    in      r17, PORTD
    andi    r17, 0xC3
    sbrc    r16, 0
    ori     r17, (1 << 5)
    sbrc    r16, 1
    ori     r17, (1 << 4)
    sbrc    r16, 2
    ori     r17, (1 << 3)
    sbrc    r16, 3
    ori     r17, (1 << 2)
    out     PORTD, r17
    sbi     PORTB, 3
    nop
    nop
    cbi     PORTB, 3
    rcall   delay_10ms
    ret

delay_10ms:
    ldi     r20, 20
d1: ldi     r21, 200
d2: dec     r21
    brne    d2
    dec     r20
    brne    d1
    ret

delay_50ms:
    ldi     r22, 5
d3: rcall   delay_10ms
    dec     r22
    brne    d3
    ret
